overview: Prepare, execute, and follow up on professional adjuster meetings. Arrive early, build rapport, advocate tactfully, and manage outcomes confidently.
learningObjectives: Document and follow up with clear homeowner communication

sections.title: Pre‑Meeting Preparation
sections.content: Arrive 15–30 minutes early; inform homeowner you’ll wait for adjuster; chalk metals day before (NOT shingles); safety equipment ready.

sections.title: DOs and DON’Ts
sections.content: DO: build rapport, be confident, be present for homeowner conversations, offer assistance. DON’T: get on roof before adjuster, be confrontational, be a pushover, take photos while adjuster inspects.

sections.title: Adjuster Communication Protocol
sections.content: Adjusters aren’t salespeople—help explain to homeowners when appropriate. Always join final homeowner conversation to ensure accurate information.

sections.title: Meeting Outcomes & Scripts
sections.content: APPROVED: celebrate, prep supplement and mortgage steps. DENIED (Reinspection Path): request different adjuster; provide photos & detailed estimate. DENIED (Retail Path): frame need; offer existing customer discount ($1,000 roof, $2,000 roof+siding). PENDING: estimate in 5–7 days; follow‑ups and portal uploads.

sections.title: Documentation & Follow‑Up
sections.content: Portrait photos, professional quality, collateral documented. Update homeowner regularly; CC on correspondence; follow timelines.

data.question: PENDING decision — what do you say?

options.text: You should receive the estimate in 5–7 days; we’ll follow up and upload correspondence to the portal
